4.title: In-class practice
4.goal: Use the need → prompt → AI code → Apps Script flow to deploy a web app for your own needs.
steps: Choose a small need and define what the web app should do.
Write a clear prompt and ask AI for the code and setup steps.
Paste the files into Apps Script, test with sample data and deploy.
Check viewer access, then share the /exec link or a screenshot.
4.hint: Create a web app on google appscript and take the googlesheet as the database, this web app is about....... (your demand).
